description: Three complete meteor evolutions share native destruction-to-evolution-source replacement. Extend native underNeo1661 destination matching with a live filtered host ability; retain full physical cards and attached Auras. Peter uses one serializable native movement batch for opponent creatures and a pre-prohibition snapshot of all mana; Byaha uses exact four-source payment then opponent-choice destruction/discard; Jiek uses exact ten-source victory. Official Aura/GR QA32471 reproduced.

rulingVerification.body: 310.8b オーラが付いているクリーチャーが、バトルゾーンにある別のカードの下に置かれる場合、付いていたオーラもそのカードの下に置かれます。この時、オーラとクリーチャーは、その持ち主が好きな順番でカードの下に置きます。 一部記載を修正しました。これによるルール変更はありません。 701.5. 実行する 701.5a カードを実行するとは、コストを支払ってカードが効果を成せる状態にすることです。クリーチャーの召喚、呪文を唱える、クロスギアをジェネレート、タマシードの実行などが該当します。

validationNotes.resolvedAttempts: Four initial failures were fixtures: Light vanilla dm01-075 is not a blocker, so Jiek evolution/decline fixtures now use the actual Light blocker dm01-076. The Aura/GR fixture now has the actual hasAuras1352 initialization flag and advance format, as set by native Aura play. All 57 final focused assertions pass, including GR later returning home when paid as a physical Meteor source. New ordering test exposed an accidental edit duplicated into heuristic scoring and an incorrect projectRoom test argument. Removed the scoring mutation, added AI purity assertion, and corrected user object/game.actions access before final checks.
validationNotes.sharedChanges: The existing underNeo1661 replacement also offers active host-defined own-other destruction destinations, with current victim filter. Its existing physical-card commit carries attached Auras under the destination, clears attachment flags and never treats it as an actual departure. Peter uses one existing movement batch with a serializable initial mana snapshot and mana-return commit after creature LKI capture, before zone-trigger flush. Rule310.8b ordering is reserved before movement and stored as native replacement-plan UIDs; the physical creature owner selects root ordering, preserving the native schema and AI purity.
validationNotes.raceWording: Official Peter HTML says グランドデビル; use the existing canonical Grand Devil race グランド・デビル for its native GV bases, without inventing a second race or changing existing race data.
